description: Joint Entrance Examination Advanced - For admission to IITs and other premier institutes

question_types.description: Multiple choice questions with single correct answer
Multiple choice questions with one or more correct answers

single_correct_mcq.description: Standard MCQ marking with negative marking

multiple_correct_mcq.description: Full marks if all correct answers selected, partial marks if some correct, negative if any wrong selected

numerical.description: No negative marking for numerical questions

matrix_match.description: Partial marking based on correct matches

difficulty_distribution.description: Percentage distribution across difficulty levels - More challenging than JEE Main

sections.name: Section A - Physics
sections.subject: Physics
sections.instructions: This section contains 66 Physics questions of various types: Single Correct MCQs (4 marks, -1 for incorrect), Multiple Correct MCQs (4 marks for all correct, partial marks possible, -2 for any incorrect), Numerical Answer Type (4 marks, no negative), and Matrix Match (3 marks with partial marking). Read each question carefully and mark your answers accordingly.

sections.name: Section B - Chemistry
sections.subject: Chemistry
sections.instructions: This section contains 67 Chemistry questions of various types: Single Correct MCQs (4 marks, -1 for incorrect), Multiple Correct MCQs (4 marks for all correct, partial marks possible, -2 for any incorrect), Numerical Answer Type (4 marks, no negative), and Matrix Match (3 marks with partial marking). Read each question carefully and mark your answers accordingly.

sections.name: Section C - Mathematics
sections.subject: Mathematics
sections.instructions: This section contains 67 Mathematics questions of various types: Single Correct MCQs (4 marks, -1 for incorrect), Multiple Correct MCQs (4 marks for all correct, partial marks possible, -2 for any incorrect), Numerical Answer Type (4 marks, no negative), and Matrix Match (3 marks with partial marking). Read each question carefully and mark your answers accordingly.

general_instructions: Total duration of the examination is 180 minutes (3 hours)
The test consists of 200 questions divided into three sections
Each section must be attempted in the given order
Use of calculator is not permitted
For Multiple Correct MCQs, select all correct options to get full marks
Partial marking is applicable for Multiple Correct and Matrix Match questions
Read instructions for each question type carefully
Negative marking is applicable for Single Correct and Multiple Correct MCQs only
